entry.author: Ministry for Pacific Peoples
entry.summary:
🌺 Cherishing Our Tongan Identity: Embracing Lea Faka-Tonga Daily 🌺
Lea Faka-Tonga is our precious heritage, a koloa (treasure) we're passing on to our children, family, and friends. It's woven into our Tongan identity and should be learned and used every day. 🗣
💬 We teach our kids through prayer, monomono making, and talanoa

Listen to Mrs Kolovula Murphy, 2021 Tonga Language Week Champion, who reminds us of the beauty of our heritage, passed on with love. ❤
Check out the video to see how we can continue sustaining and embracing Lea Faka-Tonga every day.
